description: Source code for font metrics table loading and retrieval in the FreeType project, specifically handling 'hmtx', 'vmtx', 'hhea', and 'vhea' tables in TrueType and OpenType fonts.

methods.name: tt_face_load_hmtx
methods.description: Loads horizontal or vertical metrics table ('hmtx' or 'vmtx') into a font face object.

methods.name: tt_face_load_hhea
methods.description: Loads header table ('hhea' or 'vhea') into a font face object.

methods.name: tt_face_get_metrics
methods.description: Retrieves horizontal or vertical metrics for a specific glyph in font units.
